attempts.name: v1
attempts.result: Original full upperarm axial twist produced severe pinch.

attempts.name: v2
attempts.result: Distribute axial rotation 25percent proximal plus75percent distal, recompute distal direction to fixed elbow target. Shoulder silhouette improves but elbow inner fold remains.

attempts.name: v3
attempts.result: Dual quaternion skinning added to body shader to preserve volume. Rounded forearm improves but large upperarm-to-elbow concavity still apparent at end range, and close-up thumb remains coarse.

decision: Do not encode or publish. Kinematic constraints passing do not establish visual anatomical quality. Requires further rig corrective deformation/skin weighting expertise.

validation.renderer: Edge WebGL preview completed and browser closed
